LanguageData.CC_UI_Sub_Faiths: Who holds which ideoligion and how firmly, what each asks, and who could sway whom.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_SplitTip: How split the colony is: {PCT} (0% is one ideoligion for everyone, 100% everyone their own). From half, with three ideoligions or more, the advisor speaks up.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_Intro: Who holds which ideoligion, and how firmly. Certainty is the game's own: when it runs out, someone takes up the ideoligion that wore it down. The moral guide, the conversion ritual, talks between believers and a hard turn of life move it; contentment slowly rebuilds it. Click a believer to open their page.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_None: Nobody in the colony holds an ideoligion.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_Classic: In classic mode the colony has no ideoligions to speak of.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_Off: "Ideoligions in the colony" is off in Rimfolk's settings.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_IdeoTip: The game's Ideoligion tab shows its memes, precepts and roles in full.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_RoleEmptyTip: The {ROLE} speaks for the ideoligion. With no one in the role here, its believers have no voice of their own, and an ideoligion that minds an empty role lets them feel it. The game's Ideoligion tab names one from the believers who qualify.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_Asks: What it asks that weighs on someone now
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_AsksNone: Nothing it asks weighs on anyone right now.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_SwaysNone: Nobody of another ideoligion would be moved much by its devout yet.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_SwaysNoDevout: None of its believers is devout enough to win others over.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_SwayRow: {PAWN_nameDef} → {OTHER_nameDef}: about {PTS}% of certainty in a good talk ({WHY})
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_SwayRowPlain: {PAWN_nameDef} → {OTHER_nameDef}: about {PTS}% of certainty in a good talk
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_TogetherSplit: {N} ideoligions share the colony, and {WAVERING} of its people are wavering. Certainty moves slowly, and mostly through the game's own tools:
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_ToolConvert: The moral guide's Convert ability: a talk with one colonist of another ideoligion that takes a good part of their certainty, more from someone wavering who likes the guide. Every ideoligion with a moral guide here can try.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_ToolRitual: The conversion ritual: an ideoligion's moral guide speaks to one listener of another ideoligion, with others there to see it. How well it goes decides how much of their certainty it takes.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_ToolMood: Mood and certainty: the game moves certainty a little every day by mood. Content colonists win theirs back and unhappy ones lose it, so a miserable, wavering colonist is the easiest to bring round, and a contented one slips away from it.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_ToolTalk: Talks: when two of different ideoligions talk it over kindly, a devout, well-liked colonist who comes out of it well sways the other a little. An argument only makes both dig in, and two of one ideoligion steady each other.
LanguageData.CC_FaithPg_ToolRoles: Roles: an ideoligion with a leader and a moral guide here has someone to speak for it and to bring others in; one without has no voice of its own.
LanguageData.CC_FaithP_NoteCrisisTip: A crisis of faith: a hard turn of life that shook how firmly they hold their ideoligion. It's among what shaped them, too.
LanguageData.CC_FaithP_NoteTalkTip: A talk about their ideoligion that moved them.
LanguageData.CC_FaithP_CertaintyTip: Certainty is the game's own: how firmly someone holds their ideoligion, from 0 to 100%. Devout from {DEVOUT}, wavering under {WAVERING}. When it runs out, they take up the ideoligion of whoever wore it down.
LanguageData.CC_FaithP_CertaintyDrift: The game moves it {0} a day now, by their mood: content colonists win certainty back, unhappy ones lose it.
LanguageData.CC_FaithP_AsksTip: Moods that come from the ideoligion's own precepts: what it expects of its believers (a ritual held lately, a table to eat at, a place of its own, a role filled) and doesn't have here. Giving the ideoligion what it asks lifts them; weighing on someone day after day, it can shake their certainty.
LanguageData.CC_FaithP_SwayTip: How much one good talk about their ideoligions would take off the listener's certainty: a friendly debate a devout speaker comes out of well. The open are moved more, the proud less; friends are heard, rivals hardly; an ideoligion that frowns on preaching hears half as much. Nobody is swayed by talk more than once a day.
LanguageData.CC_FaithT_NoteSwayed: swayed by {OTHER_nameDef} in a talk about {FAITH}
LanguageData.CC_FaithT_ConvertCause: The last of it was a talk about their ideoligions.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_FaithSplit_Title: The colony is split between {N} ideoligions
LanguageData.CC_Adv_FaithSplit_Detail: The colony holds {FAITHS}. No one ideoligion's rites, roles and buildings serve everyone, and each ideoligion's demands weigh on its own believers.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_FaithSplit_Tools: The ideoligions page (People) shows who holds which ideoligion and how firmly, and who could sway whom. A moral guide's Convert ability and the conversion ritual bring people round over time.
